step1.heading: Create Admin Account
step1.subheading: Pick the username and password you will sign in with.

step2.heading: Connect Your Telescope
step2.subheadingLocal: Select the type and plug in the USB drive
step2.subheadingNetwork: Select the type and enter its IP address or hostname
step2.telescopeTypeHelp: Pick your telescope model, or "Other" for a custom SMB share.
step2.poweredOnFtp: Make sure the telescope is powered on and this device is joined to its Wi-Fi, or that both are on the same network if you use station mode.
step2.poweredOnNetwork: Make sure your telescope is powered on and connected to the same network as this device.
step2.ftpDhcpNote: Leave the address at <1>192.168.88.1</1> when you join the telescope Wi-Fi directly. If you run station mode instead, set a <3>DHCP reservation</3> in your router so the address stays put.
step2.networkDhcpNote: For best reliability, configure a <1>DHCP reservation</1> in your router so your telescope keeps the same IP address.

step3.heading: Automatic Import
step3.subheading: Choose how often Nebulis checks your telescope for new files.
step3.downloadCatalogDescription: ~80 MB of reference images for Messier, Caldwell, and popular targets. Downloads in the background after setup.
step3.stackedImagesDescription: Final stacked JPG from each session
step3.fitsFilesDescription: Scientific data for processing and analysis
step3.subframesDescription: Individual exposure frames for manual stacking
step3.subframesWarning: <1>Warning:</1> Subframes can consume very large amounts of storage. A single night of imaging can produce several gigabytes of subframe data.

storageChoice.heading: Storage location
storageChoice.subheading: Where your imported images and sub-frames are stored
storageChoice.pinnedNote: Fixed by the LIBRARY_DIR environment variable.
storageChoice.customNote: Custom drive. Change any time in Settings, Storage.
storageChoice.defaultNote: Default location. Change to a USB or external drive now or later in Settings, Storage.

step4.heading: Review Setup
step4.connectionNotVerified: Connection has not been verified. You can test it later from Settings.
